title: Calibration orchestration — signed artifacts, ephemeral snapshots, and accuracy gating
creator: Anya Patel
description: Background: As we scale quantization calibration (FP8 / INT8) across hosted, dedicated and private deployments, customers need deterministic artifact lineage, a lightweight reversible snapshot model for short-lived experiments, and a secure promotion path for validated artifacts. Current console flows create long-lived calibration runs with little guardrails for accidental promotion, and teams struggle to audit which artifact produced a particular accuracy delta. This ticket defines an orchestration pattern that introduces signed calibration artifacts, ephemeral run snapshots (TTL-backed), promotion with signed approvals, and an accuracy gating step integrated with the validation harness and rollout policies.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows ephemeral snapshot option when creating a calibration run and assigns TTL in minutes/hours/days
Calibration artifacts are produced with a cryptographic signature (signed by Redwood KMS) and display signature status in artifact detail UI
Promotion flow requires an approval from a role with 'promote_artifact' permission; promotions append immutable metadata (promoter, time, validation hash)
Validation pipeline executes post-run accuracy suite and returns a pass/fail + delta metrics; pass is required for promotion when accuracy gating is enabled
Artifacts with TTL expire and are moved to a soft-archive; soft-archived artifacts are restorable by owners within retention window; permanent promotions bypass TTL and are retained per org policy
Audit trail (per-tenant) logs every create/promotion/expiry with user, IP, timestamp and signed artifact fingerprint; logs are queryable from Console trace view
API/SDK supports artifact signing verification, snapshot creation, promote/rollback operations, and a labels field for cost accounting
implementation_notes: Artifact format: tarball with metadata.json + binary blob. Metadata must include model_base_hash, data_snapshot_id, calibration_config_id, kv-cache-seed, and validation_summary_hash
Signing: use existing KMS integration (ENG-40123) to produce a detachable signature; store signature object in artifact metadata and surface verification result in UI
Ephemeral snapshot lifecycle: implement TTL on object-store keys + a background GC that moves expired objects to soft-archive bucket for N days before hard-delete
Promotion: implement server-side promotion that copies object to 'promotions/' prefix, marks 'permanent: true' in metadata and writes immutable ledger entry (append-only) with signer info
RBAC: add granular permissions for create_snapshot, promote_artifact, restore_snapshot, and purge_snapshot; map to console roles and SCIM groups
Validation harness: integrate with existing accuracy-runner (ENG-41002) and produce an immutable validation_summary JSON attached to the artifact
Costs: run-level cost estimation should capture GPU-minutes and storage for snapshot and promotions; surface estimate pre-run
Private/VPC note: ensure signed artifacts can be exported/imported offline for air-gapped customers; include HMAC option for on-prem KMS
ux_flows: Create run modal: checkbox 'Ephemeral snapshot (auto-expire)' with TTL dropdown (30m/2h/24h/7d/custom) and 'Require accuracy gating' toggle
Run detail page: shows artifact signature status, validation summary, estimated cost, and 'Promote' button (disabled until validation passes when gating enabled)

Promote dialog: shows required approvers, org policy warnings, storage cost delta, and a checkbox 'Make permanent (bypass TTL)'. 'Confirm' requires 2-step commit for P0 promotions (UI confirm + email OTP for selected orgs)
Artifact history timeline: create -> validation -> auto-expire -> soft-archive -> restore/purge -> promote/rollback, with links to PRs or eval dashboards
Admin settings: global default TTL per org, default accuracy threshold for gating, retention tiers, and compliance lock toggle
rbac_model: Roles: Run Creator, Validator, Artifact Promoter, Org Admin
Permissions: create_snapshot, read_snapshot, validate_snapshot, promote_artifact, restore_snapshot, purge_snapshot
Promotion rule: promote_artifact required + if org_policy.require_two_approvals then 2 promoters needed
Audit requirement: all promotes must include approver signature; promotions by service accounts require a corresponding ticket/trace link
retention_policy: Default ephemeral TTL: 7 days (org override allowed)
Soft-archive window after TTL: 30 days (restorable by owner or org-admin)
Permanent promotions retained per org retention tier (30/365/indefinite)
Garbage collection: daily job that annotates candidates for purge and emits pre-purge webhook to owners
Compliance-lock: an org-level flag that prevents hard-delete for compliance-sensitive artifacts until manual unlock
validation_suite: Run-level metrics: top-1/2/5 exact-match deltas, perplexity on validation set, token-level SNR for calibrated outputs
Regression gating: configurable thresholds (absolute and percentage change) against baseline artifact; failing thresholds block promotion
Replay harness: deterministic prompt set replay to compute distributional drift; results attached as validation_summary.json
Stochastic checks: run N stochastic seeds to capture variance; validation shows mean/95th-percentile
Promote-on-passing: automated pipeline can auto-promote if validation passes and auto-promote policy is enabled with a cooldown window
milestones: M1 (2026-03-05): Design sign-off on artifact format, TTL model, and RBAC (Design/PM review complete)
M2 (2026-03-19): Backend: artifact signing + TTL lifecycle + soft-archive implemented (ENG-41002)
